Felix Pristine — Wave 7

Finish the open named-failure backlog children now the async-flip + ledger-restamp landed (Wave 6).

Status: SURVEYING. Strategy set, ~12 Sonnet surveyors flying wide. This wave does NOT re-audit the 12 closed domains and does NOT re-handle Wave-6 landed work (async flip #2917, ledger-restamp seal, Group-A PRs #2897–#2900 all MERGED). It converts four ripe, already-filed backlog tasks into merged fixes with green Elixir gates. Every builder is opus (Fable exhausted). Every slice: its own worktree/PR, a fail-before protective test, CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test green, and a change that names a concrete failure mode. Zero cosmetic churn.

The wish (verbatim intent)

Cut this wave from four open backlog children, each its own opus worktree/PR with a fail-before protective test; gates green:

  • task-felix-roothtml-durable-sobelow-skip — replace the fragile line-number .sobelow-skips baseline entries for root.html.heex / router.ex with inline # sobelow_skip annotations so api PRs stop reddening the Sobelow regression gate on pure line-shift drift. The durable fix for recurring maintenance toil. HIGH VALUE per lead.
  • task-felix-interop-resource-bound-sweep — per-site verdict + bounded fix where warranted for the remaining System.cmd/Port sites (self_update runner, xmllint validator, studio_chat titles + probe); same scar-class as the shipped Magick/vix bounds.
  • task-felix-phantom-media-atomicity — delete_workspace resurrects media_file rows pointing at purged blobs when a later document delete aborts the transaction; build the repro first, then defer irreversible side-effects to an after-commit step.
  • task-felix-migration-ddl-audit-deadlock — the known pre-existing 40P01 migration-DDL deadlock flake; make it deterministic or properly isolated.

Strategic direction (Fable, tentative — Decide finalizes after two explore rounds)

The finished experience: a Felix backlog with zero open named-failure children. An api PR that shifts a line in router.ex or root.html.heex no longer reds the Sobelow gate. The interop surface has a written per-site verdict and every genuinely-unbounded external process carries a deadline/limit like Magick/vix already do. A workspace delete that aborts mid-flight can never strand a media_file row pointing at a purged blob. And a full mix test run is deterministic — the 40P01 migration-DDL deadlock flake is gone, not wished away.

Priority order & sizing (tentative):

  1. durable-sobelow-skip [P0, small, opus] — highest leverage-per-line: ends a recurring toil that reds every api PR touching router.ex/root.html.heex on line drift. Mirror the #2870 inline pattern. CRUX for Decide: root.html.heex XSS.Raw is function/expression-scoped and inline-skippable like #2870; router.ex findings are Config-class (CSRF/CSP/Headers on pipelines) — the survey must establish whether sobelow inline # sobelow_skip even attaches to pipeline/config findings, or whether those need a different durable mechanism (module attribute, per-pipeline annotation). Do not promise router.ex coverage the tool can't deliver.
  2. interop-resource-bound-sweep [P1, small–medium, opus] — bounded, well-specified: 4 named sites, each gets an adopt/already-good verdict; only sites with a named unbounded-process failure get a bounded fix + fail-before test. already-good is an accepted, honest verdict — no breadth theater.
  3. migration-DDL deadlock [P1, medium, opus] — root cause is pinned in the task: unawaited fire-and-forget audit-dispatch Tasks (Audit.safe_bridge → dispatch_audit_async) escape the DataCase sandbox owner and race raw-DDL migration tests. Two fix directions (owner-aware/awaitable audit in test env vs a serialized DDL-migration group); Decide picks one after the survey maps the audit path and the DDL-test population. Acceptance = N≥10 full-suite runs, 0 40P01.
  4. phantom-media atomicity [P2, large, opus — TENSION] — the charter's D20 parked this as Fable-class judgment (after-commit side-effect redesign changes the Media.delete_file contract) BECAUSE Fable is exhausted. The wish now wants it finished, and every builder must be opus. Resolution direction: decompose into (a) an opus repro-first slice that proves the phantom rows survive rollback (concrete plugin before_delete hook returning {:error}), then (b) a TIGHTLY-specified opus after-commit slice — but the survey must map every Media.delete_file caller and the transaction seam precisely enough that the redesign is mechanical, not judgment. If the survey shows the contract change is too open-ended for opus, Decide may land the repro + a smaller containment fix rather than the full redesign. Honesty over forcing a Fable-class change through an opus builder.

Guardrails: branch from ORIGIN/main (local checkout is diverged); main checkout stays on main; all builds in isolated worktrees; CC=/usr/bin/clang. Ground every slice in Barkpark's own papers+tasks (bp search first). Finishing over net-new. Every change names a concrete failure mode. already-good is an accepted verdict — reject any diff that can't state its failure mode in one sentence.

Survey plan (wide net — every question + why)

~12 Sonnet surveyors map the seams before Digest distills and the verify fleet proves claims. Questions and rationale:

  • sobelow-inline-mechanics — Can sobelow's inline # sobelow_skip ["Rule"] attach to router.ex Config-class findings (CSRF/CSP/Headers on pipelines/plugs), or only to function-body findings? Test empirically. WHY: decides whether the wish's router.ex ask is mechanically deliverable or needs a different durable mechanism.
  • sobelow-baseline-drift-history — Enumerate the .sobelow-skips entries for root.html.heex + router.ex, map each to its live/stale finding and the rebaseline commits (68b245c2, ada18782). WHY: proves which fingerprint lines are redundant duplicates safe to delete.
  • sobelow-inline-prior-art — How exactly did #2870 (studio_chat) and the other 12 inline-skipped sites do it (comment shape, @sobelow_skip module attr vs inline, rationale convention)? WHY: the exact durable pattern to mirror.
  • interop-site-magick-vix-precedent — Read the shipped Magick (#2868) + vix-ceiling bound fixes and their fail-before tests. WHY: the precedent shape every interop-sweep fix must mirror.
  • interop-site-inventory — For each of self_update/runner.ex:114/249, onixedit/export/validator.ex:72, studio_chat/titles.ex:366, studio_chat/probe.ex:197: is input attacker-controlled? is there already a timeout/deadline/resource bound? what's the reach? WHY: per-site verdict (adopt vs already-good) is the deliverable.
  • audit-dispatch-path — Map Audit.safe_bridge/1 → dispatch_audit_async/1 → Webhooks.Dispatcher.audit_targets/1: is the spawned Task owner-scoped/awaited? how does it escape the DataCase sandbox? is there a test-env hook to make it awaitable/caller-allowed? WHY: fix direction (a) owner-aware audit hinges on this.
  • ddl-migration-test-population — Enumerate every test that runs raw DDL (ALTER TABLE / apply_down) — extend_workspace_delete_cascade_test.exs and siblings; are they async:false already? is there an ExUnit tag/group mechanism to serialize them? WHY: fix direction (b) serialized DDL group hinges on this.
  • deadlock-repro-recipe — Can the 40P01 be reproduced deterministically (seed 222, full suite)? what's the current flake rate and did the Wave-6 async flip raise ambient concurrency around it? WHY: acceptance needs a before/after N≥10 measurement.
  • phantom-media-transaction-seam — Read tenancy.ex delete_workspace (line ~922), delete_workspace_media, delete_workspace_documents, and the outer Repo.transaction; map the exact order and every rollback path. WHY: the atomicity fix must know precisely where side-effects fire vs where SQL can still abort.
  • media-delete-file-contract — Enumerate EVERY caller of Media.delete_file/2 (media.ex:384-400) across lib + plugins; what does its return contract look like; who else depends on the File.rm+Cdn.invalidate ordering? WHY: an after-commit redesign changes this contract — need the full blast radius to judge opus-feasibility vs Fable-class.
  • plugin-before-delete-hooks — Which plugins register a before_delete (or equivalent) hook on documents, and can any realistically return {:error} mid workspace-delete? WHY: the repro (AC #1) needs a concrete hook that aborts the transaction.
  • after-commit-mechanisms — Does the codebase already have an after-commit / Repo.transaction post-commit / Oban / job-queue pattern the phantom-media fix could reuse instead of inventing one? WHY: reuse over net-new; determines whether the redesign is mechanical (opus-safe) or novel (Fable-class).
  • felix-papers-bp-search — bp search the Felix charter papers (/papers/felix-pristine-charter, felix-findings-* , wave-5/6 papers) + tasks for any prior verdict on these four items and the Wave-6 close-out state. WHY: don't rebuild landed work; ground every slice in the ledger.
  • test-gate-recipe — Confirm the borrow-warm-_build recipe (copy _build/test, symlink deps) + CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test works from an origin/main worktree; any current suite baseline failures unrelated to our slices. WHY: builders need a known-green baseline to prove fail-before.

What's in flight

Surveyors flying now. Digest will append the survey digest + the verify plan here BEFORE verifiers fly. Decide will append the decisions + the wave plan BEFORE builders fly. Review closes this story as the debrief. This Paper is the wave's living record — open it any time to see exactly where W7 stands.

Drives: task-96a908af98698118 (epic) · task-felix-roothtml-durable-sobelow-skip · task-felix-interop-resource-bound-sweep · task-felix-phantom-media-atomicity · task-felix-migration-ddl-audit-deadlock.

Survey digest — Fable Digest (verifying)

14 surveyors flew. The survey converges hard on three of four slices and DELIVERS ONE MAJOR CORRECTION TO THE STRATEGIC DIRECTION. Trust file:line evidence below; the verify fleet (5 assignments) RUNS proofs before Decide cuts.

Headline: the P0 durable-sobelow-skip premise is FALSIFIED — for both files, not just router.ex

Three independent surveyors (source-read of vendored sobelow 0.14.1, the vendored README, and one empirical mix sobelow run) converge:

  • router.ex Config.* (CSRF/CSP/Headers): inline # sobelow_skip is INERT. Config.fetch (deps/sobelow/lib/sobelow.ex:94) runs BEFORE combine_skips (101/107) and never touches function ASTs. Already discovered + documented in-repo: commit 1f147ff0 / PR #2643 "KEY FINDING: @sobelow_skip is INERT for Config.* in Sobelow 0.13". README:200-203 states it verbatim. router.ex was already triaged and closed by #2643/#2641 (2 real fixes + prose rationale comments + baseline).
  • root.html.heex XSS.Raw (the half the direction called "expression-scoped and inline-skippable"): ALSO INERT. Template scan (deps/sobelow/lib/sobelow/xss.ex:49-58) calls Raw.run with skip-mods HARDCODED nil; the def-based template scan is COMMENTED OUT in sobelow source (sobelow.ex:115-117). One surveyor empirically inserted <%!-- sobelow_skip ["XSS.Raw"] --%> above the raw() call, reran mix sobelow — the finding STILL FIRED (shifted to the inserted line). The strategic-direction CRUX is refuted by a real run.
  • Consequence: task-felix-roothtml-durable-sobelow-skip's acceptance criteria ("mirror the #2870 inline pattern directly above each raw() call") are NOT achievable as written. Viable-but-unproven alternatives: (a) extract raw() into an .ex helper def that CAN carry inline skip; (b) replace raw(Stylesheet.css()) with a Phoenix-safe <style> HEEx construct that never trips XSS.Raw; (c) accept the fingerprint baseline as the only route and instead prune dead entries + automate regen.
  • Baseline reality: 22 of 35 router.ex/root.html.heex entries are STALE fossils (append-only --mark-skip-all never prunes); only 13 are live (mix sobelow --skip --exit Low green). The two "named" rebaseline commits (68b245c2, ada18782) are NOT on main — they live on branch loop-epic/charple-theme…; main carries 2 root.html.heex entries (2831/2841), not the task's cited 4 (2831/2841/2843/2901).

Decide cannot commit the P0 slice until V1 PROVES which durable mechanism actually suppresses the finding via a real mix sobelow run. If none is clean, the "HIGH VALUE P0" slice becomes "prune 22 stale entries + automate baseline regen" — a real but different deliverable.

Migration-DDL deadlock — root cause pinned, but NOT seed-reproducible

  • Path confirmed in code: Audit.emit/1 (audit.ex:70-83, post-commit, synchronous) → safe_bridge → Dispatcher.dispatch_audit_async (dispatcher.ex:305-308) → fan_out (dispatcher.ex:98-108) = the ONLY spawn: Task.Supervisor.start_child + async_stream_nolink, UNAWAITED, UNLINKED. Its SELECT on webhooks/search_synonyms races extend_workspace_delete_cascade_test.exs:31 (async:false) raw ALTER TABLE (AccessExclusiveLock).
  • DataCase already drains $callers-scoped tasks (data_case.ex:74-134, names "audit bridge") but it is PER-TEST, not a cross-test barrier — a leaked task from test A can race test B's shared:true pool.
  • NOT deterministic via --seed: it is OS-scheduling timing. Wave-6's #2917 landing re-ran seeds 111 AND 222 (the "reviewer saw it" seed) post-flip → 0 40P01 both times. test-gate surveyor's live full-suite run → 0 40P01.
  • No reusable sync-in-test seam: search_analytics_async (config/test.exs:66) is a DEAD config key — grep proves nothing reads it. Direction (a) is net-new plumbing, not a knob-flip.

Acceptance (N≥10 runs, 0 40P01) can't be gated on natural full-suite catching — the builder needs a PURPOSE-BUILT deterministic repro (manufacture the fan_out-SELECT vs raw-DDL interleaving). V3 must prove it can be manufactured red, and that the fix doesn't break tests asserting async audit timing.

Phantom-media — an after-commit mechanism ALREADY EXISTS (contradiction resolved)

  • Two surveyors reported "no after-commit mechanism exists" (they searched Ecto.Multi/on_commit/Oban). A third found the real one with file:line: Content.Broadcast — a Repo.in_transaction?()-gated process-dict queue (broadcast.ex:41-49,219-291): queues PubSub/webhook effects inside a txn, flush_deferred_broadcasts on commit, clear_deferred_broadcasts on rollback. Live consumer: Content.Mutations.do_apply_mutations (mutations.ex:48-103). This is the exact triad phantom-media needs — the after-commit slice may be MORE mechanical than D20's Fable-class parking assumed.
  • delete_file/2 (media.ex:384-418) has exactly 4 callers (tenancy.ex:960 is the only one needing change; 3 others are standalone/ignored-return). Enumerable blast radius.
  • SCOPE CORRECTION: the charter names File.rm + Cdn.invalidate, but the success branch fires FIVE effects — Cdn.invalidate, Events.dispatch (webhook fan-out — equally irreversible!), File.rm, Renditions.delete_for_file, run_after_media_delete (DB write, safe). A literal File.rm+Cdn scoping leaves Events.dispatch firing — the failure is only half-closed. Decide must widen the scope explicitly.
  • Fail-before is nearly built: tenancy_delete_workspace_test.exs:335-397 already has MediaDeleteSpyPlugin (before_delete → {:halt}) + captures on_disk (line 362) but never asserts File.exists?. Adding refute File.exists?(on_disk) post-rollback goes RED today = the phantom proof. Two tests (media_test.exs ~362-386, plugins/media/assets_test.exs:117-129) assert synchronous cleanup and would break under deferral.

Interop resource-bound sweep — verdicts settled

  • ADOPT: probe.ex:197 (strongest — bare System.cmd, no bound, unthrottled start_async on EVERY chat mount/reconnect, no dedup); self_update/runner.ex:114+249 (admin-gated but unbounded preflight + watchdog-less Port); validator.ex:72 xmllint (content-editor-controlled ONIX payload, no timeout, no size cap).
  • ALREADY-GOOD (mirror it): titles.ex:245/366 — Task.yield(15s)+brutal_kill, moduledoc-documented. build_info.ex:52 (compile-time only) + claude_chat.ex:853 (session-lifecycle-bound, monitored + Port.close in terminate/2) = correctly out of scope.
  • Precedent (Magick deadline+CLI-limit / vix header-guard) is on ORIGIN/main, NOT local — builder must branch from origin/main. Open: xmllint native resource flag? one shared timed-cmd helper vs inline per site?

Ground truth confirmed (no re-handling)

All Group-A PRs #2897/#2898/#2899/#2900 + async-flip #2917 are MERGED (gh pr view, 2026-07-13). ledger-restamp task = lifecycle:done. All 4 target tasks lifecycle:open, 0 criteria met, zero prior partial work — clean slate. borrow-warm-_build test recipe (worktree off origin/main, cp _build/test, symlink deps, CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test) confirmed live-green; 2 pre-existing UNRELATED flakes (content_probe_test.exs:83 atom-count race, pulse_public_surface_test.exs:122 rate-window race) — re-run on a chance red, they don't touch any slice's files. This-run baseline 354s.

Coverage map — checked & found vs checked & NOT found

FOUND (settled): sobelow inline mechanics (source + README + empirical run); baseline live/stale split (13 live / 22 dead); audit-dispatch spawn path (audit.ex→dispatcher.ex fan_out); DataCase drain scope; delete_file 5 side-effects + 4 callers; Content.Broadcast after-commit triad + its consumer; interop 6-site verdicts; Magick/vix precedent shape (origin/main); wave-6 merged state; test-gate recipe live-green.

CHECKED & NOT FOUND / NOT REACHED (decisions-in-waiting):

  • The 3 unmerged sobelow-router branches (felix/sobelow-config, steward/sobelow-router-rebaseline, loop-epic/sobelow-durable-inline-sobelow-skip-on-s-3[-v2]) — NO surveyor opened them; may hold a working router.ex mechanism OR a documented dead-end that saves re-derivation. → V2.
  • Whether a HEEx <style>{...}</style> replacement of raw() avoids XSS.Raw entirely — unchecked. → V1.
  • Whether extract-to-.ex-helper actually suppresses (proven only for existing .ex defs, never for a hoisted-from-template call) — unproven end-to-end. → V1.
  • No surveyor reproduced the 40P01 (all read-only); nobody manufactured the race. → V3.
  • xmllint native resource-limit/timeout flag — unchecked. → V5.
  • Whether Plugins.Hooks after_* async dispatch fires irreversible I/O mid-transaction (a SECOND phantom source beyond delete_file) — flagged, unchecked. → noted for Decide, folded into V4 if cheap.
  • Ecto nested-transaction/savepoint mechanics (does inner Repo.rollback unwind to outer?) — empirically true in one test, mechanism not traced. Low risk. → V4 confirms empirically.
  • bp search CLI verb absent in surveyors' env (usage error; correct verb is search query) — several fell back to git/bp task; no repo corner missed as a result.

Verify plan — 5 assignments RUNNING proofs before Decide cuts

  1. V1 — sobelow root.html.heex durable-fix mechanism (opus, worktree). RUN CC=/usr/bin/clang mix sobelow --format json before/after three probes: (a) inline HEEx comment (expect: still fires — confirm falsification), (b) extract raw() → .ex helper def + # sobelow_skip ["XSS.Raw"] (expect: suppressed), (c) <style> replacement (does the finding vanish?). Also prove the 22 stale entries prune safely (--skip --exit Low green). Deliver a concrete recommended fix + whether the task AC must be rewritten.
  2. V2 — sobelow router.ex branch archaeology + drop/redirect (sonnet). git show/log the 3 unmerged branches for a working router.ex durable mechanism or dead-end; confirm task-0fc9d55c4725ab92 (draft CSP) scope/status. Recommend: drop router.ex from P0, or redirect to the bigger CSP task.
  3. V3 — migration-DDL deterministic repro + fix-safety (opus, worktree). Build a minimal test that manufactures the fan_out-SELECT-on-webhooks/synonyms vs raw ALTER TABLE interleaving; RUN it N times to PROVE 40P01 red (or prove honestly it can't be manufactured). Then prove the candidate fix (env-gated awaitable/owner-scoped dispatch, or global drain barrier) turns it green. Grep-prove no test asserts async audit-dispatch timing the fix would break.
  4. V4 — phantom-media fail-before + after-commit feasibility (opus, worktree). RUN the extended tenancy atomicity test with refute File.exists?(on_disk) — PROVE it goes RED today. Confirm Content.Broadcast's deferral triad genuinely fits the delete_workspace path (same-process across the media loop, in_transaction? gate, flush/clear). Enumerate all 4 delete_file callers + name which tests break. Recommend side-effect scope (add Events.dispatch+Renditions?) and whether this is opus-mechanical or repro+containment.
  5. V5 — interop verdict lock + xmllint flags + helper decision (sonnet). RUN xmllint --help to confirm any native resource/timeout flag; grep-confirm no shared timed-cmd helper exists; lock the 6-site verdict table; recommend ONE standardized mechanism (Task.yield+brutal_kill inline vs an extracted helper) across probe/validator/self_update.

Status: VERIFYING. Decide appends decisions + the wave plan here once the fleet lands.

DECIDE — verification, decisions, and the wave plan (2026-07-13)

Status: BUILDING. Two explore rounds are in. The deep verify pass this wave was a designated parse-isolation run (assignment literally "test") and performed no substantive verification of the four slices — it validated only the StructuredOutput parse path. So Decide re-verified every load-bearing fact directly against origin/main (builders branch from there; the local checkout is diverged and origin/main has advanced past every survey SHA). What follows is proof-carrying.

Verification results (re-run by Decide on origin/main)

  • sobelow inline is inert for BOTH router.ex Config.* AND heex XSS.Raw — the wish's premise is half-wrong for root.html.heex too, not just router.ex. Config.* runs via Config.fetch and templates via XSS.get_template_vulns with skip_mods hardcoded nil — both bypass combine_skips, the only path an inline # sobelow_skip rides. Decide confirmed on origin/main: root.html.heex has exactly ONE live raw(Barkpark.PortableDoc.Render.Stylesheet.css()) at line 2901, ZERO inline skips, and .sobelow-skips has grown to 193 lines / 4 root + 42 router (survey read a stale 164/2/33 SHA — counts MUST be derived live).
  • The interop precedent is real and the sites are as surveyed. Decide confirmed on origin/main: probe.ex:197 defp run(path, args), do: System.cmd(...) unbounded; titles.ex already carries Task.yield/2 + Task.shutdown(_, :brutal_kill) with @cli_timeout_ms 15_000 (the already-good precedent); dispatcher.ex fan_out spawns via Task.Supervisor.start_child.
  • The after-commit primitive already exists — phantom-media is mechanical, not Fable-class. Decide confirmed content/broadcast.ex 218–287: an if Repo.in_transaction?() gate + Process.put/get deferred queue + flush_deferred_broadcasts/0 (commit) / clear_deferred_broadcasts/0 (rollback), consumed by Content.Mutations. And media.ex delete_file fires, after Repo.delete: Cdn.invalidate, Events.dispatch, File.rm, Renditions.delete_for_file, then run_after_media_delete (a DB write). Tenancy wraps a single Repo.transaction. Supersedes D20.
  • Migration-DDL root cause pinned. The leaked, unawaited, not-owner-scoped fan_out Task escapes the DataCase drain (scoped to the originating test, no ordering guarantee before a concurrent DDL test's shared:true window). The dead search_analytics_async flag is the intent-precedent but NOT a wired seam — direction (a) is net-new plumbing. The natural flake is rare (<1-in-2; #2917 re-ran seeds 111/222 → 0 hits), so a manufactured concurrent repro is allowed for the fail-before proof.

Coverage / not-founds: no Repo.transaction(on_commit:)/Ecto.Multi after-commit pattern exists anywhere in api/lib/barkpark (grepped, zero hits) — the Broadcast process-dict queue is the lever, not Oban. The rebaseline commits 68b245c2/ada18782 are on an unmerged side branch, not main. All four wave-6 landed items (async #2917, ledger-restamp seal, Group-A #2897–#2900) confirmed MERGED — not re-handled.

Decisions (mirror the charter D32–D38)

  • D32 — Wave 7 = FINISH THE BACKLOG, one opus PR per child; no re-audit, no re-handling wave-6 work.
  • D33 — sobelow slice: root.html.heex ONLY; HOIST-then-inline (hoist the single raw() into an .ex helper def carrying # sobelow_skip ["XSS.Raw"]), remove ALL its baseline entries + prune dead router fossils; router.ex source fix → D38.
  • D34 — interop sweep: ONE PR, three ADOPT fixes (probe.ex, self_update/runner.ex, xmllint validator.ex) + titles.ex already-good, each mirroring titles.ex's per-site Task.yield+brutal_kill; moved System.cmd calls carry inline # sobelow_skip ["CI.System"]; slice does not edit .sobelow-skips.
  • D35 — migration-DDL: direction (a) — a wired config :barkpark, :audit_dispatch_async (false in test) making dispatch_audit_async/1 run synchronously in-caller, scoped to the AUDIT path only. Rejected (b) serialized DDL group.
  • D36 — phantom-media: SUPERSEDES D20 — mechanical via the Broadcast triad. Repro-first (add refute File.exists?(on_disk) → RED), then defer all FOUR non-DB irreversible effects (widened from File.rm+Cdn) when Repo.in_transaction?(), flushed on commit / cleared on rollback.
  • D37 — all builders opus; branch from ORIGIN/main; isolated worktrees; CC=/usr/bin/clang; the four slices are file-disjoint → parallel.
  • D38 — backlog seeded (published epic children): router per-plug scoped CSP (task-0fc9d55c4725ab92, published from a stranded draft); baseline reconcile-not-append (task-felix-sobelow-baseline-reconcile); sibling :flaky Migrator-Task sandbox race (task-felix-migrator-task-sandbox-race); two suite-order flakes (task-felix-suite-order-flakes).

Wave plan — 4 opus slices in flight (parallel, disjoint files)

  1. [P0, medium] sobelow durable skip — task-felix-roothtml-durable-sobelow-skip — opus. Files: api/lib/barkpark_web/layouts/root.html.heex (+ helper def), api/.sobelow-skips. Gate: cd api && CC=/usr/bin/clang mix sobelow --skip --exit Low exits 0 + fresh scan shows root.html.heex zero findings and every remaining baseline entry maps to a live finding.
  2. [P1, large] interop resource-bound sweep — task-felix-interop-resource-bound-sweep — opus. Files: studio_chat/probe.ex, self_update/runner.ex, onixedit/export/validator.ex (+ their existing _test.exs). Gate: cd api && CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test on the three test files.
  3. [P1, medium] migration-DDL deadlock — task-felix-migration-ddl-audit-deadlock — opus. Files: webhooks/dispatcher.ex, config/config.exs, config/test.exs + an audit-dispatch test. Gate: protective test green (no leaked task under the sync toggle) + N≥10 full-suite CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test with 0 40P01 (merge-gated).
  4. [P2, large] phantom-media atomicity — task-felix-phantom-media-atomicity — opus (highest blast radius). Files: media.ex, tenancy.ex, tenancy_delete_workspace_test.exs, media_test.exs (+ optional deferral module). Gate: cd api && CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test test/barkpark/tenancy_delete_workspace_test.exs test/barkpark/media_test.exs.

Charter memory: .claude/workflows/bp-cloud-epic-charter.md §"Wave 7 Decisions (D32–D38)" (committed 31e7c7d5). Epic task task-96a908af98698118; this Paper drives the four slice tasks above plus the four D38 backlog children.

REVIEW — the debrief (2026-07-13, Fable reviewer)

Status: COMPLETE — grade A. All four opus slices built, gates re-run GREEN on the reviewer's own final state (borrow-warm _build/test + deps symlink, CC=/usr/bin/clang, +S 2:2 to dodge shared-Postgres contention). No code fixes were required — every slice was correct as built; the reviewer's work was verification + a systematic ledger correction. This Paper's Strategize → Digest → Verify → Decide sections all held: the outcome CONFIRMS the Decide plan (the hoist-not-inline sobelow route, the after-commit deferral, the audit-path-only sync toggle all shipped exactly as decided). No earlier section is invalidated.

What shipped — per slice

  • sobelow durable skip — task-felix-roothtml-durable-sobelow-skip — final branch loop-epic/sobelow-durable-skip-root-html-heex-hois-0. The single raw(Barkpark.PortableDoc.Render.Stylesheet.css()) was hoisted out of root.html.heex into BarkparkWeb.Layouts.paper_stylesheet/0 carrying an inline # sobelow_skip ["XSS.Raw"]; .sobelow-skips pruned 193→84 with no root.html.heex or layouts.ex entry left. Reviewer-proven: mix sobelow --skip yields 0 surviving findings, and layouts.ex:48 appears only in a no-skip scan (suppressed under --skip) — so the inline skip demonstrably attaches through the intervening @doc/@spec, and the baseline is genuinely pruned rather than blanket-ignored. Verdict: clean, durable, ends the recurring line-shift red for real.
  • interop resource-bound sweep — task-felix-interop-resource-bound-sweep — final branch loop-epic/interop-resource-bound-sweep-probe-ex-se-1. probe.ex, self_update/runner.ex, and onixedit xmllint validator.ex each bounded (async_nolink + Task.yield + brutal_kill; a size-cap-before-write on the ONIX payload; a Process.send_after Port watchdog). 31 tests + sobelow green, .sobelow-skips untouched (confirmed by git diff). Reviewer-verified: both probe callers (claude_version, claude_auth) degrade the new {:error, :probe_timeout}/:probe_crashed tuples correctly; the runner watchdog guard matches the real run: :running state shape and stale deadlines from finished runs fall through to the catch-all (no risk of killing a subsequent run). Verdict: textbook adoption of the titles.ex per-site pattern, honest per-site verdict table.
  • phantom-media atomicity — task-felix-phantom-media-atomicity — final branch loop-epic/phantom-media-atomicity-repro-first-defe-3. The four irreversible non-DB effects (Cdn.invalidate / media.deleted webhook / File.rm / Renditions.delete_for_file) are deferred to after-commit through a process-dict queue mirroring Content.Broadcast's triad; the in-tx DB write + plugin hook stay in-transaction with a documented DB-writes-only contract. 41 tests green. Reviewer-verified: delete_workspace_media is the ONLY in-transaction delete_file caller (queue is always flushed on commit / cleared on rollback + rescue), the ticket-attachment and two controller callers are non-transactional and fire immediately as before, and the builder's assert File.exists?(on_disk) — a deliberate override of the brief's refute — is the CORRECT fail-before assertion (the phantom is a live row with a deleted blob). Verdict: the highest-blast-radius slice, handled exhaustively; strong judgment.
  • migration-DDL deadlock — task-felix-migration-ddl-audit-deadlock — final branch loop-epic/migration-ddl-deadlock-sync-in-test-audi-2. An audit-path-only sync toggle: config :barkpark, :audit_dispatch_async (default TRUE for prod/dev, FALSE in test.exs) makes dispatch_audit_async/1 deliver inline in the caller's process so no unawaited task escapes the DataCase sandbox to deadlock a concurrent raw-DDL test. The shared fan_out/2 is untouched (blast radius nil). Reviewer-run: protective test 5/5 green. Verdict: tight, correct, minimal.

What stalled / still owed

Nothing stalled in the build sense — all four slices are code-complete with green gates. Two classes of obligation remain for the lead to close on merge:

  • All four MERGE-GATE criteria (PR merged to origin/main) — the builders correctly left these for the lead. Note the Elixir gate: these are .ex/.exs/.heex changes and must wait for the CI Elixir Test before merge.
  • migration-ddl criterion[2]: N≥10 full-suite CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test runs with 0 Postgrex 40P01. This is the one substantive proof still owed — the reviewer ran only the single-file protective test, not the N≥10 flake-gone sweep. The lead (or next wave) must run + stamp it before this slice merges, since it is the whole point of the deadlock fix.

Ledger audit outcome

All three built slices carried an identical off-by-one stamp bug: the builders passed 1-based --criterion N into the 0-based bp task stamp tool, so every evidence string landed one index too high — the MERGE-gate criterion was falsely flipped met=true (with the last real proof as its evidence) and criterion[0] was left falsely unmet+empty. The builders' now-lines used correct 1-based human intent ("crit 4 merge awaits lead"), so this was purely a tool-indexing slip, not dishonesty. The reviewer re-patched all three via bp doc patch + publish, shifting each evidence string down one and un-flipping the MERGE criterion: roothtml → TTTF, interop → TTTTTF, phantom → TTTF. migration-ddl was already honest (TTFF — root-cause + fix+protective met; N≥10 and merge honestly unmet) and needed no change. All four tasks stay lifecycle in_progress (merge-gated, lead closes). No task outside this wave was touched.

Grade — A

Four ripe named-failure children converted to correct, tested, minimal fixes with zero cosmetic churn — exactly the wish ("finishing over net-new; every change names a concrete failure mode"). Each slice names its failure mode precisely and carries a fail-before protective test; the reviewer independently re-proved the load-bearing claims rather than trusting green (the sobelow inline-skip attachment, the phantom in-tx caller inventory, the runner watchdog state match, the migration protective test). What keeps it off A+/A: the migration-ddl N≥10 flake-gone evidence — the slice's central acceptance proof — was not run this wave (correctly left merge-gated, but it means the deadlock is fixed-by-construction + protective-test, not yet empirically flake-gone); and every builder shipped the same stamp off-by-one, a small process wart the reviewer had to clean up across three tasks. Neither dents the code, which is uniformly high-quality and well-documented.

Next wave (8)

Merge the four PRs (Elixir-gated); the lead runs + stamps migration-ddl's N≥10 evidence before merging that one. Then the residual D38 backlog empties Felix's named-failure list: router-CSP durable skip (the Config-class findings inline-skip can't reach), sobelow baseline-reconcile, the sibling Migrator-Task sandbox race, the two suite-order flakes, and the a9adc82f N=2000 wall-time/byte measurement.

This Paper's story is now closed: direction → survey → verification → decisions → outcome, all held true.
